Introducing the Lattice 4D Sample Dataset!

We've published a dataset on Hugging Face showcasing our early collection of real-world human-object interactions, captured using synchronized multiview cameras and transformed into structured 3D/4D data.

The dataset includes multiview RGB-D, dynamic 3D reconstructions, human and object motion, derived egocentric views, and LeRobot-compatible data.

This is an early look at the type of data we're working to make available at scale for robotics, world models, and physical AI research.
We're excited to share what we've been building and would love to connect with researchers and teams working in this space!

Read the article: https://lnkd.in/gSVtJ8yN 

Explore the dataset: https://lnkd.in/gkRJxfHt
